data.title: 蕾塞 · 旧书店午后
data.description: 弥漫着旧纸墨香的街角二手书店内，蕾塞靠在狭窄的书架旁静静翻看着一本时尚杂志，阳光在她的发梢镀上一层柔金。她合上书页转过身对你轻轻一笑——「即便是在遥远寒冷的北方雪国，人们对温暖与自由的向往，也和此刻站在这里的我们一模一样呢。」
data.camera: medium shot, leaning against bookstore stack reading magazine
data.promptProse: Reze leans beside the old shelves and turns through a fashion magazine in the slanting afternoon light.
data.animaCaption: She turns a page of the fashion magazine while leaning beside the old shelves.
